name: Image to Image
description: Image to Image is an overview page: browse 21 image editing models and example edits, then open Edit Studio to edit your photo.
shortDescription: Browse image editing models and examples, then edit a photo in Edit Studio.
fullDescription: Image to Image (#/image-to-image) is a starting page, not an editor. It has a 'Ready to Transform?' section with 'Get Started Free', four 'Powerful Image Editing' highlight cards, an 'Available Models' grid of 21 editing models and tools, five 'Example Transformations' cards, and a 'Start Editing Now' section with 'Start Editing' and '🎯 GTM Boost'. There is no upload, prompt box or Generate button here: every button and card opens Edit Studio (#/edit). Edit Studio does not pick up the model or example prompt you clicked here, so choose the tool and write the edit in Edit Studio. For prompt-based image-to-image with a reference photo you can also use Image Studio (#/image), which switches to image-to-image when you add a reference image.
bestFor: Users who want to see what kinds of image edits and models are available before opening Edit Studio.
whenToUse: You want an overview of image editing models (Nano Banana Edit, Flux Kontext, GPT Image Edit, Seededit and more).
You want ideas for transformations (watercolor, film noir, cyberpunk...).
You want a quick link into Edit Studio.
whenToUseAnother: Use Edit Studio (#/edit) directly to upload a photo and run a tool.
Use Image Studio (#/image) for prompt-based image-to-image: add a reference image and it switches to image-to-image models.
Use Text to Image (#/text-to-image) when you have no photo and want to start from words.
keyFeatures: 'Get Started Free' and 'Start Editing' buttons that open Edit Studio.
'Available Models' grid of 21 editing models and AI tools.

featureExplanations.explanation: The 'Get Started Free' button in the 'Ready to Transform?' section opens Edit Studio (#/edit).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Fastest way to the photo editing tools.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Nothing is edited on this page.

featureExplanations.explanation: Four information cards: 'Smart Transformations', '55+ Models', 'Style Transfer' and 'Professional Tools' ('Background removal, face swap, skin enhancement & more'). They are not buttons.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Summary of the kinds of edits available.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Marketing text: the page grid lists 21 models while the card says '55+ Models'.

featureExplanations.explanation: A grid of 21 cards ('Choose from 21+ powerful editing models'): editing models (Nano Banana Edit, Flux Kontext Dev/Pro/Max I2I, Flux Redux, Flux Pulid, GPT-4o Edit, GPT Image 1.5 Edit, Midjourney v7 I2I, Seededit v3, Bytedance Seedream Edit, Qwen Image Edit, Wan Image Edit, Ideogram Character) and AI tools (AI Background Remover, AI Face Swap, AI Dress Change, AI Skin Enhancer, AI Product Shot). Clicking a card opens Edit Studio.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: See which editing models and tools exist.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Edit Studio does not pre-select the model you clicked; pick the matching tool there (for example Remove Background, Face Swap, Change Dress, Enhance Skin, Product Shot).

featureExplanations.explanation: Five example cards with a model badge and 'Try this →' (for example 'Convert to watercolor painting style with soft colors' with Nano Banana Edit). Clicking one opens Edit Studio.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Ideas for what to write when you edit.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Edit Studio does not fill in the example text; copy the idea into the edit prompt yourself.

featureExplanations.explanation: In 'Start Editing Now' ('Upload an image and let AI transform it'), 'Start Editing' opens Edit Studio, where you upload your image.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Open the editor after reading the page.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: None here; the upload happens in Edit Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: The '🎯 GTM Boost' button opens the GTM Boost window ('🎯 GTM Boost · Image Edit'). You write your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and click the Boost button to get a conversion-focused prompt. 'Apply' closes the window and opens Edit Studio, but Edit Studio does not read the prompt, so copy it with the Copy button first and paste it yourself.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a rough marketing idea into a ready-to-use prompt before you start.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An idea in step 1 (otherwise the window says 'Add your ... idea first.').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Without an OpenAI key the window shows 'Add your OpenAI key for AI-written results. Until then GTM Boost uses a built-in template.'

howToUse: 1. Open Image to Image (#/image-to-image). 2. Browse 'Available Models' and 'Example Transformations' for ideas. 3. Click 'Get Started Free', 'Start Editing', a model card or an example: Edit Studio (#/edit) opens. 4. In Edit Studio choose a tool, upload your image, describe the edit if the tool asks, and run it.
howToSteps: Pick an idea from the model or example cards.
Click 'Start Editing' (or any card) to open Edit Studio.
In Edit Studio, choose a tool and upload your image.
Run the edit in Edit Studio.
gettingStarted: Read the 'Example Transformations' for edit ideas.
Click 'Start Editing' and upload a photo in Edit Studio.
For a free-form prompt edit, try Image Studio with a reference image instead.

limitationDetails.impact: Edit Studio opens without that model chosen.
limitationDetails.workaround: Choose the matching tool in Edit Studio, or use Image Studio's model picker with a reference image.

troubleshooting: Edit Studio did not use the model I clicked: this page does not pass the model to Edit Studio; pick the tool there.

A prompt I clicked here appeared later in Image Studio or Video Studio: the page stores the example text for the studios, and Edit Studio does not use it up, so the next Image, Video or Cinema Studio visit fills it in. Clear the prompt box there.

troubleshootingSteps.issue: Unexpected prompt in Image Studio later
steps: Clear the prompt box in Image Studio.

faqs.question: Can I generate directly on this page?
faqs.answer: No. This page has no prompt box, upload, ratio or Generate button. Every button and card opens Edit Studio (#/edit), where the actual generation happens.

faqs.question: Where can I do prompt-based image-to-image with a reference photo?
faqs.answer: In Image Studio (#/image): add a reference image and it switches to image-to-image models.

glossary.Prompt: The text you write to tell the AI what to make.
glossary.Model: The AI engine that makes the result; each one has its own style and options.
glossary.Prefill: When this page passes a prompt or model to the studio so it is already filled in when the studio opens.
glossary.GTM Boost: A helper window that rewrites your idea as a marketing-focused prompt (GTM = go-to-market).
glossary.Image-to-image: Making a new or changed image starting from a photo you supply.

tips: Use the example texts as wording ideas for your edit prompt.
For background removal, face swap, dress change, skin or product shots, use the matching Edit Studio tool.
bestPractices: Treat this page as a menu; do your uploads and edits in Edit Studio or Image Studio.
